decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already captures the requirement that mixing remain smooth and not become overly aggressive at higher speeds.
A same-message MODIFY already captures the 3000 RPM maximum, adjustable mixing range, and restriction against normal operation at maximum speed.
The source discusses splash control and smoothness during high-speed mixing, not dispensing flow or froth preservation through the spout.
Possible whisk-position adjustment is presented conditionally as a splash-control method and does not change the selected whisk head, material, size, or powder compatibility.
Keeping high-speed mixing clean refers to controlling splashing, not changing bowl or spout removal and cleaning behavior.
The client accepts higher adjustable speed subject to mixing-quality and splash constraints but does not alter the repeated-use reliability requirement.
The source does not change the solenoid mechanism, button actuation, closed-state behavior, or pre-dispense isolation.
Bowl-depth adjustment is only a conditional splash-control option; the source does not necessarily change bowl capacity, compactness, or current bowl form.
The source does not change the requirement that bowls be quickly removable and swappable.
Splash containment during mixing is distinct from preventing valve dripping and liquid leakage into the base or electronics.
The conditional possibility of a splash guard does not necessarily alter the enclosure's size, side profile, or accommodation of deep wells.
The high-speed splash-control decision has no effect on the beige and green color scheme.
